firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
I am releasing the exact notebook version that received **1.17 on the ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard**, together with our experiment ledger covering **11 official submissions and 300 public-game diagnostic rows**.

## Links

- **Notebook (exact 1.17 version):** https://www.kaggle.com/code/yw8837/lb-1-17-arc-agi-3-qwen3-6-duck-full-code
- **Dataset (run history + per-game diagnostics):** https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/yw8837/arc-agi-3-run-history-300-game-diagnostics

## What is in the 1.17 notebook?

- Base: the open Tufa ARC-AGI Framework (TAAF) / Duck harness by Tufa Labs and Jeroen Cottaar.
- Model: `vrfai/Qwen3.6-27B-FP8`.
- Hardware: Kaggle RTX PRO 6000.
- Runtime: 2h 21m 29s for the saved version.
- Baseline runtime settings retained: concurrency 28 and 7,920 seconds per game.
- Patch 1: if an identical cardinal direction leaves the visible board unchanged inside a batch, stop before blindly repeating it and return control for re-observation.
- Patch 2: increase the local analyzer yield window from 60 to 90 seconds to allow an extra inspection/tool cycle on difficult turns.

The notebook is public under Kaggle's Apache 2.0 notebook license. The attached TAAF source bundle is marked MIT. I am explicitly crediting the upstream project because this is a controlled extension of that open harness, not a from-scratch solver claim.

## Local 25-game diagnostics for this run

The corresponding public-game run completed **15 levels**, used **3,908 actions**, generated **1,770,675 tokens**, and had a mean local game score of **0.8839**. These are diagnostic statistics only; they are not an estimate of the hidden public-LB score.

## Why release the full ledger?

Our 11 official submissions scored:

`1.29, 1.05, 0.71, 0.73, 0.68, 0.75, 0.55, 1.11, 1.17, 0.90, 0.94`

That spread is a useful warning: more local actions, tokens, or public-game levels did not reliably improve the hidden score. The dataset records the exact hypothesis, source SHA-256, runtime budget, aggregate result, and all 25 per-game rows for each run so others can analyze the failures as well as the successes.

## Reproduction notes

1. Copy the notebook and keep all three attached inputs.
2. Select **RTX PRO 6000**; internet remains disabled.
3. Run the notebook without changing the customization cell.
4. Expect trajectory variance. The published 1.17 is the verified score of Version 1, not a guarantee that every rerun will reproduce the same scalar.

Technical feedback and independent reproductions are welcome, especially evidence about when the repeated-no-effect guard helps or hurts across games.

Upstream reference: https://www.kaggle.com/code/jeroencottaar/tufa-labs-duck-harness-june-30-milestone-winner
